notes.order2_indicator: the order-2 error indicator values of stage1_o2 and stage1_o2_lossy (and of the other order-2 runs) were measured before the indicator's residual problems moved to the canonical complement (docs/physics/fullwave_error_indicator.md): they were not rerun. The GPU-CPU comparisons stand: both devices ran the same code, the local solves run on the host in both builds, and without the tree the host effect is 1e-11

iron.description:
A saturated iron core in a coil (tests/test_3d.py::test_saturated_iron_newton_3d): Newton, with a new
    operator and AMS setup at every step.

pillbox_ame.description:
The TM010 pillbox of tests/test_cavity3d.py with skin-effect walls, solved by hypre's AME eigensolver (LOBPCG
    with AMS): f, the form factor and the wall losses, whose wall-current solve once lost them on a GPU.

pillbox_si.description:
The same pillbox with the shift-invert eigensolver (STRUMPACK LU of A - sigma M on the host; hypre for the
    projections), target 1.1 GHz.

pillbox_rod_si.description:
The pillbox with an off-centre retained conductor rod (wall faces between the cavity and a conductor volume),
    shift-invert at 0.6 GHz.

stage1_direct.description: Stage 1 at 1 MHz, the STRUMPACK direct full-wave solve (AXF_FW_SOLVER=strumpack)

stage1_tc.description: Stage 1 at 0.1 MHz, the tree-cotree gauged STRUMPACK solve (AXF_FW_GAUGE=tree-cotree)

stage1_o2_lossy.description: Stage 1 at order 2, 1 and 12 MHz, with a weakly conducting block (0.0167 S/m) in the loop's opening: the order-2 error indicator's complex-eps gradient projection (GMRES with PRESB)
